sections.text:
This
document lists the equipment inspection, which must be performed every Six months
as indicated by M6 in the title block 
 for 220kv disconnect switch (DSB)
The first draft initiated by Eng. Saleh El-Sayed Saleh and revised by 
Operation and maintenance's General Director: eng Mohamed Reda Abd El-Azez

items:
A
 work permit must be issued.

The switch
 should be cleaned to remove contaminant particles

Check for
 loose bolts and nuts, tighten if needed.

Examine the
 contact surfaces for wear pitting.

If a bright surface is desired use fine steel wool to 
 polish, wipe, clean, and apply 
 " NO - OX -ID " A special grease to the surface, remove grease
with clean rag.

If severe damage has occurred, replace the damaged part with
Allis charmer's replacement
ports.

Examine the 
 switch blade- contact alignment and realign if necessary.

Check
 all galvanized surfaces for chips. If chipping has occurred use Galvanox R2
 or equivalent as a touchup.

Introduction
This
document lists the equipment inspection, which must be performed every Six months
as indicated by M6 in the title block 
 for 220kv disconnect switch (DSB)
The first draft initiated by Eng. Saleh El-Sayed Saleh and revised by 
Operation and maintenance's General Director: eng Mohamed Reda Abd El-Azez
Safety Precautions
A
 work permit must be issued.
Tools
and Equipment
A complete set
 of tools.
Work
to be Carried Out
The switch
 should be cleaned to remove contaminant particles
Check for
 loose bolts and nuts, tighten if needed.
Examine the
 contact surfaces for wear pitting.
If a bright surface is desired use fine steel wool to 
 polish, wipe, clean, and apply 
 " NO - OX -ID " A special grease to the surface, remove grease
with clean rag.
If severe damage has occurred, replace the damaged part with
Allis charmer's replacement
ports.
Examine the 
 switch blade- contact alignment and realign if necessary.
Check
 all galvanized surfaces for chips. If chipping has occurred use Galvanox R2
 or equivalent as a touchup.
